subject: Re: Helios Labs — Order Form commercial / PO & tax handoff
messages:
From: Emily Stewart <emily.stewart@helioslabs.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helioslabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Order form questions — invoice timing, PO & tax

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for walking us through the order form yesterday. A couple of quick items procurement needs clarified before we can route a PO to finance:

- Invoice cadence: the OF v3 shows quarterly invoicing for the committed tranche and monthly for usage overage. Can you confirm the exact trigger for the quarterly invoice (calendar quarter vs 90-day periods)? Helios finance wants an exact date schedule so they can plan cashflow.

- Net terms: can Redwood accept Net 45 for this enterprise purchase? Our standard is Net 45 with some vendors — accounting requires that in the PO. If Net 45 is an exception, what approvals do you need?

- Tax proof: our tax team requires a Redwood tax/residency certificate or a template showing Redwood's VAT/responsibility clause for cross-border supplies. We can attach our tax certificate as well.

- PO template: attached is our preferred PO template (Procurement_PO_Template.pdf). We will populate entity details once the invoice cadence and net terms are final.

Can you confirm the above in a single reply so we can move to PO issuance?

Appreciate it —
Emily
Procurement Lead
Helios Labs

Attachment: Procurement_PO_Template.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stewart <emily.stewart@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helioslabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice timing, PO & tax

Emily — thanks for the clear list. Summarizing so procurement has a single view and we can hand off to ops/legal for redlines: 

1) Invoice cadence: The committed tranche invoices are aligned to calendar quarters (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct). Our finance ops will issue the first invoice on the start date of the contract and then on each calendar quarter boundary. Usage overage will be billed monthly and shown as a separate line item. I will attach the order form (Helios_OrderForm_v3.pdf) with the explicit invoice schedule called out.

2) Net terms: Our standard is Net 30. For enterprise deals we can consider Net 45 with an approval path — typically requires Revenue Mgmt sign-off + Finance director approval. Ben, can you confirm whether we can take Net 45 for HL and what level of discount/commitment would be required?

3) Tax / residency: Please attach your tax certificate (you mentioned). We will also collect Helios' tax entity on the PO. On our side, legal will confirm the tax clause (whether Redwood gross-ups or responsibility lies with the buyer). Kimberly, I've looped you in — can your team advise expected language and turnaround for a redline? Mina, FYI for tax evidence retention.

Next steps / mutual action plan:
- Ben to confirm Net 45 approval path and whether commercial terms need adjustment (by EOD 7/20).
- Kimberly to propose redline comments on Helios_OrderForm_v3 and confirm tax clause (by 7/20).
- Chloe to provide DocuSign link once OF v3 is approved and procurement confirms PO entity (target 7/21).

We attached Helios_OrderForm_v3.pdf with the invoicing schedule highlighted.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Helios_OrderForm_v3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Stewart <emily.stewart@helioslabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice timing, PO & tax (redlines attached)

On Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emily Stewart <emily.stewart@helioslabs.com> wrote:
> Chloe — thanks for the clear list...

Team — I reviewed Helios_OrderForm_v3 and prepared a short redline set. High level:

- Tax allocation: propose explicit buyer-responsibility language for local withholding/vat with a reciprocal obligation for Redwood to provide tax invoices and any supporting residency certificates. This avoids a gross-up in most markets. If Helios requires Redwood to gross-up, the commercial team should indicate acceptable margin/offset.

- Net terms: legal is neutral on Net 45, but we need an explicit exception in the order form ("Net 45 by mutual written agreement"), and Finance must sign off on any cashflow exposure. We will not change the MSA base Net 30 without leadership approval.

- PO & invoice acceptance: add a clause that a properly issued PO (matching entity and remit details) must be provided prior to the first invoice for the committed tranche. If Helios cannot provide a PO in time, the committed tranche will still auto-bill to the entity on the order form but we can defer recognition of payment terms until PO receipt for invoicing workflow purposes.

I'll attach Helios_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf with in-line comments (short turnaround). If procurement can confirm the legal remit entity and attach the tax_certificate_helios.pdf, we can push to DocuSign.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Helios_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stewart <emily.stewart@helioslabs.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice timing, PO & tax

Emily — quick commercial confirm: Redwood can accept Net 45 for this deal provided Helios signs to the committed 12-month minimum (the staged commit ladder we discussed) and we maintain the agreed price bands. No additional discount required, but Net 45 will trigger Finance approval and a one-time credit hold assessment.

To move: please send over the completed PO (use the attached template) with the billing entity and remit details + the tax_certificate_helios.pdf. Once we have those, I'll finalize the order form (I agree with Kimberly's small redlines), upload to DocuSign and share the link here.

HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-2026-0921
Signing link (will be live after PO/tax arrives): https://www.docusign.net/Helios-HL-2026-0921-sign

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
